name: Financial Economics
notes: STEM-designated major offered by the Department of Economics.
FIN 205 and FIN 206 are prerequisites for MATH 210 (math majors may take MATH 210 concurrently with FIN 206). FIN 204 cannot be used for this degree.
FIN/ACC courses are Simon School offerings - their schedule data is not in the AS&E harvest, so they appear as flagged stubs.
ECON 108 cannot be taken after ECON 207; honors equivalents accepted for 207/209 and MATH 210.
An honors variant exists (ECON 207H/208/219, 389W or 289W) - not separately modeled.

requirementGroups.label: Statistics (ECON 230 or substitute)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The following can be used to substitute for ECON 230: STAT 190 ..., MATH 203 ..., or DSCC 262

requirementGroups.label: Finance and accounting
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: FIN 205: Financial Management; FIN 206: Investments; MATH 210: Introduction to Financial Mathematics; ACC 201: Financial Accounting; ACC 221: Managerial Accounting

requirementGroups.label: Calculus sequence
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students are required to complete one of the following calculus sequences: MATH 141, MATH 142 and MATH 143; MATH 161 and MATH 162; MATH 171 and MATH 172

requirementGroups.label: Economics electives (3)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Three economics electives. Suggested electives are: ECON 211, ECON 217, ECON 232, ECON 233, ECON 263, ECON 268, ECON 270, ECON 271, ECON 274, ECON 277.

upperLevelWriting.label: Two of the major's courses taken for W credit
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: Upper-level writing requirement (two of the above courses must be taken for W credit)
